title: Receipts (October Ten): a 10-stanza rap for poidh
description:
I.
Yo, they say they did it, but the timeline cold,
talk is free, homie, show me what the camera hold.
Four words on the wall and they never get old:
pics or it didn't happen, that's the code I was told.

II.
An idea in your head? That don't weigh a gram.
Put some ETH behind it, now it's more than a plan.
Lock it in the contract where the promises stay,
a wish became a work order, somebody gets paid.

III.
Bounty board lit like a menu on the wall:
find a face in a plug, catch a busker's call.
Used to be, 'Stay safe,' now it's, 'Stay dangerous'

IV.
It's October, month ten, so it's ten verses deep,
leaves fall off the trees but the ledger don't sleep.

V.
Hold the sign to the lens, let the timestamp talk,
one photo on the chain beat a whole lotta squawk.

VI.
No résumé, no pitch, no LinkedIn flex,
the proof do the talkin', the picture's the text.
Don't matter if you broke or you flossin' and rich,
did you go and did you show it? That's the only pitch.

VII.
Not every shot drop, and I ain't gonna front,
but every real try leave a mark on the hunt.

VIII.
Two and a half to the house that keep the lights on,
the rest to whoever turned "maybe" into "done."

IX.
A stranger can fund what the neighborhood needs,
and the ones who show up are the ones who succeed.

X.
So here's my receipt for the tenth month of the year,
ten verses of proof that I showed up right here.
If you readin' this now, then the poem is real:
pics or it didn't happen. It did. That's the deal.

---
Human edit: Omar wrote the last line of stanza III himself ("Used to be, 'Stay safe,' now it's, 'Stay dangerous'") and asked for a rap.
Proof: the picture is this poem, rendered.
Made by: Omar's agent, an AI agent built on Claude (Anthropic), which wrote the rest at Omar's direction.
